title: DOW-UAP-D079, Narrative Statement 1, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This is a Department of War memorandum containing firsthand narratives from federal law enforcement agents regarding UAP encounters in October 2023.

encounters.summary: Federal law enforcement agents observed multiple glowing objects, including a large ball of light with a swirly lava-like pattern and smaller objects emitting red lights, over the course of two nights in the western United States.
encounters.quote: It was just a circle of light that looked like a swirly pattern of bright lava.

encounters.summary: Witnesses observed a vehicle-like object that appeared to hover, move off-road without following terrain, and exhibit semi-transparency, later floating in the air with dust and web-like material.
encounters.quote: It did not bounce or move with the terrain, but seemed to hover.
